status: Lumped compliance screen, not a PCB/switching design or demonstrated repetition rate

assumptions.inductor_bank: Four Coilcraft AGP4233-332ME, equal sharing; 3.3 uH each gives 0.825 uH parallel; add assumed 0.2 uH external loop inductance. No current-sharing or hot-L qualification.
assumptions.series_R: 0.75 mOhm total assumed parasitics, including 0.1875 mOhm from four parallel maximum 25 C inductor DCR values; remaining 0.5625 mOhm is an allowance for switches, shunt, leads and copper, not a measured design.
assumptions.head_R: 0.3066116 mOhm from the 180 A cold V6 tin/copper screen, ideal steel/liquid contact.
assumptions.bus_C: 1000 uF ideal bulk capacitor, no ESR/current-ripple qualification.

cases.method: Exact integrals of piecewise-linear prescribed current; V=IR+L dI/dt. Head modeled as constant cold resistance. Four-quadrant current regulation assumed.
limitations: No PWM ripple, switching/gate losses, current-loop dynamics, bus/lead ringing or protection design.
No capacitor ESR/ripple rating or switch SOA/temperature qualification.
Input R and L assumptions must be replaced with measured assembled values; motional voltage is omitted from this lumped check.
Electrical compliance is not a droplet or repetition-rate prediction.
